submitted.rationale: At 2.06 eV, BiVO4 (gap about 2.4 eV) cannot absorb, so the photoactivity has to come from narrow-gap copper vanadates. Photocurrent rose with Cu content: 0 A at index 19 (V-rich, Cu 0.27), 1.2e-7 A at index 73 (Cu 0.48), and 1.7e-7 A at index 74 (Cu 0.54, V 0.39). Index 74 has a Cu:V ratio near Cu3V2O8 and is the most Cu-rich candidate in the vanadate-rich part of the library.

rejected.reason: Measured 0 A. V-rich compositions with a lot of BiVO4 do not absorb 2.06 eV photons.
Not measured. It is expected to be dominated by CuBi2O4/CuO, which are p-type materials and poor photoanodes.
